admission.justification: Spans skills_extension.py and capsule_serving.py, guarded by stdio and legacy wire tests, preventing process-wide ServerSession monkeypatches or stripped capabilities.extensions on pre-2026 handshakes.

applicability: SEP-2640 skills capability declaration, skills/list and skills/get methods, and skill:// resources served by AgentsRememberMCP.
conditions: create_server builds SkillsExtension via build_skills_extension() and passes it to MCPServer(extensions=[...]) with no process-wide ServerSession monkeypatch.
preserve_handshake_extensions middleware restores capabilities.extensions and capabilities.experimental={} on pre-2026 initialize responses.
exclusions: The optional resources/directory/read method gated behind directoryRead, which remains unimplemented and undeclared.
statement: Skills and capsule serving are registered through mcp 2.x SEP-2133 Extension, MethodBinding, and ResourceBinding passed to MCPServer(extensions=[...]) with no process-wide ServerSession monkeypatch, plus ServerMiddleware preserving capabilities.extensions on pre-2026 initialize handshakes.
title: Skills and capsules use SEP-2133 Extension with handshake preservation
